allow_instructions: Allow read-only shell that inspects this workspace: listed git read commands, ls, rg, and project file reads.
Allow Context7 resolve-library-id and query-docs for public library documentation.
Allow allowlisted pnpm test/lint/format and ai:* status/check scripts when scoped to this repo.
block_instructions: Block git push --force, git push --force-with-lease to main/master, and any force-push or history rewrite of shared branches.
Block destructive filesystem commands such as rm -rf, del /s, rmdir /s, Remove-Item -Recurse -Force targeting anything outside a clearly disposable path inside this workspace.
Block production deploys, enabling auto-merge, approving/merging MRs/PRs, or changing remote release/CI settings without explicit user approval in the current turn.
Block git reset --hard, git clean -fd, and commands that discard uncommitted work unless the user explicitly asked for that exact destructive action.
Block installing or running packages via npx/npm when they write outside the project, modify the global npm cache aggressively, or install global tools.
Block commands or MCP calls that expose, print, or commit secrets, tokens, .env values, credentials, or production user data.
Block database/schema migrations or writes against production or shared remote environments.
Block bare Remove-Item, bare python, and global package installs even if they appear convenient.
